td: { 	"@context": "https://www.w3.org/2019/wot/td/v1", 	"@type": "Thing", 	"title": "Smart Surveillance Camera", 	"description": "WoT-enabled smart camera for surveillance", 	"id": "urn:dev:wot:org:dcns:camera", 	"securityDefinitions": { 		"basic_sc": { 			"scheme": "basic", 			"in": "header" 		} 	}, 	"security": ["basic_sc"], 	"properties": { 		"videoStream": { 			"type": "object", 			"description": "Current video stream from the camera", 			"observable": true, 			"readOnly": true, 			"properties": { 				"cameraId": { 					"type": "string", 					"description": "Unique identifier of the camera" 				}, 				"timestamp": { 					"type": "string", 					"description": "Timestamp of the video frame" 				}, 				"videoStream": { 					"type": "string", 					"description": "Encoded video stream (e.g. base64)" 				} 			}, 			"forms": [{ 				"href": "http://localhost:8080/camera/stream", 				"contentType": "application/json", 				"op": ["readproperty", "observeproperty"] 			}] 		} 	}, 	"actions": { 		"setPTZ": { 			"description": "Set the PTZ position", 			"input": { 				"type": "object", 				"properties": { 					"cameraId": { 						"type": "string", 						"description": "ID of the camera to control" 					}, 					"ptz": { 						"type": "object", 						"properties": { 							"pan": { 								"type": "integer", 								"minimum": -100, 								"maximum": 100 							}, 							"tilt": { 								"type": "integer", 								"minimum": -100, 								"maximum": 100 							}, 							"zoom": { 								"type": "integer", 								"minimum": 0, 								"maximum": 100 							} 						} 					} 				}, 				"required": ["cameraId", "ptz"] 			}, 			"forms": [{ 				"href": "http://localhost:8080/ptz/actions/setPTZ", 				"contentType": "application/json", 				"op": "invokeaction" 			}] 		} 	}, 	"events": {} }
